scene: The brass lens reveals routes branching from the sparkling snowy square.
picture: Side-scrolling pixel art along a snowy cobblestone street. Left, a chairlift terminal swings two wooden seats. Centre, the lanky boy in his orange puffer vest, white scarf, and kite stands beside the domed cart. Right, an icy canal holds a glass-bottomed boat. Far right, a rainbow hot-air balloon floats tethered beside a lamppost.
shown: a dangling two-seat wooden chairlift swinging gently at a platform on the far left
a glass-bottomed blue skiff moored at an icy canal dock on the right
